decisive_items: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures
local invasion into adjacent blood vessels was seen
response.rationale: R3 specifies hepatocellular carcinoma with malignant cytologic features and invasion, while R2 is a generic neoplastic category lacking histologic specificity.

rejected.why: Overly broad; does not identify the hepatocellular origin or malignant features.
